text:
maya: Pushed an updated Variant Inspector hover mock — focuses on collapsed columns, keyboard navigation, and a lightweight snap-view affordance. Preview (Figma): https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/variant-inspector
DeployBot: Preview published to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/preview/variant-inspector-218001
sam: Looks much cleaner. +1 for hiding badges until hover, keeps density down. Main concern: discoverability for keyboard and screen reader users. Can we add an explicit focus state and a short hint like 'press Enter'?
jing: Agree re keyboard. Hover hit area feels a little narrow at 1200px. Suggest increasing interactive target to 40px vertically. Quick CSS idea:
```css
.variant-row:hover .metric-badge { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
.variant-row:focus .metric-badge { opacity: 1; outline: 2px solid var(--focus); }
```
alex: Perf nit: avoid layout reflow when badges appear — use opacity + transform so the document flow doesn't shift. Also memoize badge rendering if we have 200+ rows in the table.
maya: Good calls. We'll switch to transform-based animation. For keyboard hint: plan is SR-only text plus a small visible tooltip on focus. Open question on microcopy: 'Show metrics' vs 'View metrics' vs 'Open preview' — which is clearest?
len: I think 'View metrics' reads best. 'Open preview' might imply a larger modal. Also we need to ensure aria-describedby links to the tooltip for screen reader users.
sam: +1 'View metrics'. For visible tooltip, keep it short: 'View metrics (Enter)'. For SR text: 'Press Enter to open the Variant Inspector and view metrics for this model version.'
jing: One more a11y item — current badge bg color in mock (#6B7280 on white) is borderline for contrast at small sizes. Recommend darker token or add a 1px stroke.
alex: Add pref-reduced-motion support too — if prefers-reduced-motion, collapse instantly with no animation. Also test with large tables to ensure no jank when focusing via keyboard nav.
DeployBot: Reminder: Accessibility review scheduled 2026-03-29 10:00 AM PT. RSVP: https://calendar.example.com/event/ACCESSIBILITY-REVIEW
maya: Thanks everyone. I'll iterate the mock with: larger hit area, transform-based reveal, focus ring, aria-describedby and updated copy 'View metrics'. Will push new figma link + updated staging preview by EOD and ping back here. :thumbsup:
